abstract: Cloudways is a good managed cloud host. DevOpsCube measured a GTmetrix grade of A. The Black Friday discount lasts only 2 months.

citation.name: Cloudways support: how to use the Cloudways MCP server

name: Jamil Ahmed
description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a good managed cloud host for people who want a cloud server without server work. DevOpsCube measured a GTmetrix grade of A on a WordPress test.
DevOpsCube tested WordPress on a 2 GB DigitalOcean server and reported a GTmetrix grade of A with Core Web Vitals passed.
Flexible plans on DigitalOcean start at $14 a month at list price. Autonomous plans start at $99 a month. AI Agents plans start at $9.99 a month.

mainEntity.name: Does Cloudways have a free trial?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Cloudways lists a 5-day free trial on Flexible plans with no card needed, and a 3-day trial on Autonomous plans.

mainEntity.name: What is the Cloudways Black Friday offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: 80% off for 2 months on all plans, with code BFCM802 shown on the pricing page. The page we read shows no end date.
It lists Cloudways Copilot, AI Agents plans and an MCP integration. We did not test them.
